name: Stop Motion
description: The timeline of a stop-motion film of toy-brick scenes: the scene is code in a code editor's scene.js tab, the film plays in Brick Studio, the screen, and scrubs on the timeline, exports as an MP4, and saves to the Drive as one film (its set and its scene). A scene plays sound with sound.at(time, sound, { volume, until }) or actor.sound(time, sound, { volume, until }) to follow an actor across the picture: the sound is any audio file in the Platform named by its URI, charmiq://file/<assetId> (an Asset you upload, download, or generate: create_audio and create_music return assetIds; use 'charmiq://file/' + assetId)

charmiq.command.name: describeFilm
charmiq.command.description: How the film stands: the studios and code editors found, whether the scene is staged, and the film the scene.js tab makes (its title, seconds, fps, frames, actors, views, its camera's shots from cut to cut and the set each starts on, its set keys, the sounds it plays, every two actors that come within 2 studs and where, and what it logged), or the scene's mistake and its line, and the sounds a scene can play

stage.description: none, ambiguous (more than one studio holds a build), staging, staged, left (the person went back to the build) or failed

shots.description: The camera's shots: from each cut (or the start) to the next (or the end), seconds, named by its cut

set.description: The build's set standing as it starts, when the scene keys one by then (the build's first set otherwise)

sets.description: Each set.at key: from when (seconds) the build's set it names stands, until the next

sounds.description: Each sound the scene plays (sound.at, or an actor's .sound to follow it): from when (seconds), the sound (a Platform file's charmiq://file/<assetId> URI, or a shipped sound's name), its volume (1 as recorded), until when it plays over and over (absent: once) and the actor it follows

shippedSounds.description: The few sounds Stop Motion ships for its example films, playable by name (sound.at(1, 'engine')). A film's own sounds are files in the Platform, played by URI

close.description: Every two actors that come within 2 studs (once the studio has staged the film), each where they come closest: the gap between their boxes in studs, 0 touching

file.description: The film's file in the Drive: its name once saved or opened, and whether the set or the scene changed since (a film never saved has changed)

charmiq.command.name: seek
charmiq.command.description: Show one moment of the film in the studios, by time (seconds) or frame (from 0); resolves once the studio has drawn it, so a screenshot next sees it

charmiq.command.name: storyboard
charmiq.command.description: Show a storyboard of the film on the Brick Studio holding the build: up to 12 of its frames at once, each captioned with its time, frame and shot, through a view when named (a plan view shows each moment from above, with every actor's path and the camera). Resolves once the sheet shows; take an Application screenshot of that Brick Studio to read it. The sheet closes when the film next moves. Left without times or frames, it shows the middle of each shot

view.description: One of the scene's views (the film's camera when left out)

charmiq.command.name: measure
charmiq.command.description: Where two actors come closest over the film (or from and to, seconds): the frame, the gap between their boxes in studs (each box its footprint turned by its yaw and its height, unposed; 0 when they touch) and where each stood

positions.description: Each actor's position then: x east and z north in studs, height in plates

charmiq.command.name: listFilms
charmiq.command.description: The films (and designs) in the films folder of the Drive, each by name and uri

charmiq.command.name: saveFilm
charmiq.command.description: Save the film (the main Brick Studio's build, the set, and the scene.js tab's scene) as one film in the Drive: under name in the films folder, or over its own file (the one it was opened from or saved as, wherever it is) when it has one. Another film of that name is refused unless replace is true

folder.description: The folder saved to, when known

charmiq.command.name: openFilm
charmiq.command.description: Open a film from the Drive (its uri from listFilms, or its name): its set into the main Brick Studio's build and its scene into the scene.js tab. A plain design opens its set alone, the scene kept. Refused while the film has unsaved changes unless discard is true

scene.description: Whether the file carried a scene

charmiq.command.name: newFilm
charmiq.command.description: Start a new film: the main Brick Studio's build cleared (its ground kept) and a starter scene in the scene.js tab. Refused while the film has unsaved changes unless discard is true; save the film first to keep it

charmiq.command.name: where
charmiq.command.description: Where every actor shown stands at a moment, by time (seconds) or frame (from 0), and how it is turned (yaw clockwise seen from above, degrees), and where the film's camera stands and looks: x east and z north in studs, height in plates

set.description: The build's set standing, when the scene keys one by then (the build's first set otherwise)
